observations: Two identical photos show four slide sandals in black, off-white, orange, and black.
Each strap has a rectangular patch reading 'COACH NEW YORK' with a horse-and-carriage logo.
The footbeds are black with a textured surface and a white sticker near the heel.
The separate outsole shown at the top has a deep tire-tread pattern.
A watermark across the footbeds reads 'PEN WHOLESALE AND VARIES'.
All four slides face the same direction with heels to the left.

risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded generic slide sandals.

risks.if_unproven: priced as four single slides, not pairs.
